newsitem.title: USA: Zurn to buy Eljer Industries for $173 million.
newsitem.headline: Zurn to buy Eljer Industries for $173 million.

text.p: Zurn Industries Inc. said Monday it agreed to buy Eljer Industries Inc. for about $173 million in cash, strengthening its position in the plumbing, heating, ventilation and air conditioning markets.
Zurn will commence a tender offer of $24 a share for all of Eljer's roughly 7.2 million shares outstanding by Friday.
Eljer's board has recommended that the Dallas-based company's shareholders accept the offer, Zurn said.
Eljer's stock jumped $10.125, or 75 percent, to $23.625, while Erie, Pa.-based Zurn fell $1.50 to $24.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
Eljer makes plumbing, heating and ventilation products for home and commercial construction, remodeling and repair and had 1995 revenues of $397 million.
Zurn makes plumbing products and provides water resource construction services and fire protection systems. It had fiscal 1996 revenues of $421.5 million.
"The acquisition of Eljer fits perfectly with Zurn's strategic focus on plumbing products and the growth of those businesses," said Robert Womack, Zurn Chairman.
Eljer's U.S. Brass Corp. subsidiary is operating under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and on Dec. 2 fled its third amended reorganization plan.
